title: QingGanJianPi oral solution ameliorates hyperlipidemia by facilitating crosstalk between multiple active metabolites and the PPARalpha-LXRalpha axis.
authors: Wang, Jinji; Jing, Chenxu; Han, Yuna; Zhu, Zhijie; Yang, Ming; Zhuang, Xuefeng; Zhou, Kaixuan; Liu, Jia; Li, Lijing
journal: The Journal of pharmacy and pharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方通过代谢物激活PPARalpha-LXRalpha轴调节脂质代谢，虽涉及分子对接但核心是代谢通路与药效，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制研究。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: QingGanJianPi oral solution (QGJP), a traditional Chinese patent medicine, exhibits lipid-lowering and hepatoprotective effects. This study aimed to elucidate the mechanisms by which QGJP promotes lipid and cholesterol efflux. METHODS: Drug efficacy was evaluated in HFD-mice. Serum metabolomics combined with network pharmacology was performed to predict the relative signaling pathways involved. Molecular docking and thermal stability assays were conducted to identify active ingredients interacting with potential targets. The mRNA levels and protein expression were analyzed by qPCR and Western blotting. KEY FINDING: QGJP significantly reduced serum lipid levels in a dose-dependent manner. It also effectively attenuated high-fat diet-induced body weight gain and fat deposition. Untargeted serum metabolomics combined with network pharmacology revealed activation of the PPARalpha-LXRalpha-ABCA1 signaling axis following treatment. Among the circulating metabolites, salvianolic acid A was found to activate PPARalpha, thereby promoting the interaction between PPARalpha and LXRalpha, and enhancing the expression of downstream target genes. Furthermore, emodin upregulates ABCA1 expression mainly through direct activation of LXRalpha, with limited dependence on PPARalpha. CONCLUSIONS: Salvianolic acid A and emodin upregulate ABCA1 expression via multiple mechanisms, including direct activation of LXRalpha or activation through PPARalpha, thereby demonstrating the multi-target advantages of traditional Chinese medicine and providing preliminary insights into the synergistic interactions among its complex metabolites.
abstract_zh: 目的：清肝健脾口服液（QGJP）是一种传统中成药，具有降脂和保肝作用。本研究旨在阐明QGJP促进脂质和胆固醇外排的机制。方法：在高脂饮食（HFD）小鼠中评估药效。结合血清代谢组学与网络药理学，预测所涉及的相对信号通路。采用分子对接和热稳定性实验，鉴定与潜在靶点相互作用的活性成分。通过qPCR和Western blotting分析mRNA水平和蛋白表达。主要发现：QGJP以剂量依赖性方式显著降低血清脂质水平，并有效减轻高脂饮食诱导的体重增加和脂肪沉积。非靶向血清代谢组学结合网络药理学揭示，治疗后PPARalpha-LXRalpha-ABCA1信号轴被激活。在循环代谢物中，丹酚酸A被发现可激活PPARalpha，从而促进PPARalpha与LXRalpha的相互作用，并增强下游靶基因的表达。此外，大黄素主要通过直接激活LXRalpha上调ABCA1表达，对PPARalpha的依赖性有限。结论：丹酚酸A和大黄素通过多种机制上调ABCA1表达，包括直接激活LXRalpha或通过PPARalpha激活，从而展示了中药的多靶点优势，并为其复杂代谢物间的协同相互作用提供了初步见解。
